summary: fortinet.fortios supports check_mode on all configuration modules and added FortiOS 7.6.1 and 7.6.2 support.
questions: Do fortinet.fortios configuration modules support check mode?

answer_card.title: fortinet.fortios check mode and 7.6.x
answer_card.answer_md: In Ansible 12.0.0, fortinet.fortios supports **check_mode on all configuration modules**, adds support for FortiOS **7.6.1 and 7.6.2**, and fixes examples to use valid min/max values.
